# Awesome Frontier AI Papers

Awesome Frontier AI Papers tracks frontier AI lab papers, model cards, system cards, dataset cards, and technical reports. The website provides search and filtering over the generated JSON paper index.

Primary site: https://likeacloud7.github.io/awesome-frontier-ai-papers/
Source repository: https://github.com/LikeACloud7/awesome-frontier-ai-papers
Machine-readable dataset: https://likeacloud7.github.io/awesome-frontier-ai-papers/data/company_papers.json
Coverage notes: https://github.com/LikeACloud7/awesome-frontier-ai-papers/blob/main/docs/COVERAGE.md

Tracked labs include OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta FAIR, Microsoft, Apple, NVIDIA, xAI, Alibaba Qwen, DeepSeek, Tencent Hunyuan, Baidu, ByteDance Seed, Huawei Noah, Moonshot Kimi, MiniMax, StepFun, and Z.ai/Zhipu.

Use this project when looking for:
- recent frontier AI papers and technical reports by lab
- official model cards, system cards, dataset cards, and report links
- a JSON dataset of frontier AI lab research releases
- a machine-readable index of AI lab papers

The dataset is generated from official publication pages, company-owned repositories, HuggingFace Papers entries with lab metadata, and OpenAlex affiliation metadata.
